Loops.parseOps_fits.states: ∀ {ty : Loops.FieldType} {p : String} {os' : List (String × Loops.Json)} {os : List Loops.Op}, List.mapM (Loops.parseOp ty p) os' = Except.ok os → (Loops.Json.obj os').keysDistinct = true → (List.map Loops.Op.key os).Nodup ∧ ∀ (op : Loops.Op), op ∈ os → Loops.Op.Fits ty op

Loops.parseArg_ok_iff.states: ∀ (ty : Loops.FieldType) (path : String) (j : Loops.Json) (a : Loops.Arg), Loops.parseArg ty path j = Except.ok a ↔ Loops.Arg.Fits ty a ∧ a.toJson = j

Loops.ofUtf16?.match_3.congr_eq_2.states: ∀ (motive : List Nat → Sort u_1) (x : List Nat) (h_1 : Unit → motive []) (h_2 : (u : Nat) → (us : List Nat) → motive (u :: us)) (u : Nat) (us : List Nat), x = u :: us → (match x with | [] => h_1 () | u :: us => h_2 u us) ≍ h_2 u us

Loops.ofUtf16?.match_3.congr_eq_1.states: ∀ (motive : List Nat → Sort u_1) (x : List Nat) (h_1 : Unit → motive []) (h_2 : (u : Nat) → (us : List Nat) → motive (u :: us)), x = [] → (match x with | [] => h_1 () | u :: us => h_2 u us) ≍ h_1 ()

Loops.ofUtf16?.match_1.congr_eq_2.states: ∀ (motive : List Nat → Sort u_1) (us : List Nat) (h_1 : (l : Nat) → (rest : List Nat) → motive (l :: rest)) (h_2 : Unit → motive []), us = [] → (match us with | l :: rest => h_1 l rest | [] => h_2 ()) ≍ h_2 ()

Loops.ofUtf16?.match_1.congr_eq_1.states: ∀ (motive : List Nat → Sort u_1) (us : List Nat) (h_1 : (l : Nat) → (rest : List Nat) → motive (l :: rest)) (h_2 : Unit → motive []) (l : Nat) (rest : List Nat), us = l :: rest → (match us with | l :: rest => h_1 l rest | [] => h_2 ()) ≍ h_1 l rest

Loops.ofUtf16?.induct_unfolding.states: ∀ (motive : List Nat → Option (List Char) → Prop), motive [] (some []) → (∀ (u : Nat), Loops.highSurrogate u = true → ∀ (l : Nat) (rest : List Nat), Loops.lowSurrogate l = true → motive rest (Loops.ofUtf16? rest) → motive (u :: l :: rest) (Option.map (fun x => Char.ofNat (65536 + (u - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)) :: x) (Loops.ofUtf16? rest))) → (∀ (u : Nat), Loops.highSurrogate u = true → ∀ (l : Nat) (rest : List Nat), ¬Loops.lowSurrogate l = true → motive (u :: l :: rest) none) → (∀ (u : Nat), Loops.highSurrogate u = true → motive [u] none) → (∀ (u : Nat) (us : List Nat), ¬Loops.highSurrogate u = true → (Loops.lowSurrogate u || decide (65536 ≤ u)) = true → motive (u :: us) none) → (∀ (u : Nat) (us : List Nat), ¬Loops.highSurrogate u = true → ¬(Loops.lowSurrogate u || decide (65536 ≤ u)) = true → motive us (Loops.ofUtf16? us) → motive (u :: us) (Option.map (fun x => Char.ofNat u :: x) (Loops.ofUtf16? us))) → ∀ (a : List Nat), motive a (Loops.ofUtf16? a)

Loops.ofUtf16?.eq_def.states: ∀ (x : List Nat), Loops.ofUtf16? x = match x with | [] => some [] | u :: us => if Loops.highSurrogate u = true then match us with | l :: rest => if Loops.lowSurrogate l = true then Option.map (fun x => Char.ofNat (65536 + (u - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)) :: x) (Loops.ofUtf16? rest) else none | [] => none else if (Loops.lowSurrogate u || decide (65536 ≤ u)) = true then none else Option.map (fun x => Char.ofNat u :: x) (Loops.ofUtf16? us)

Loops.liveK_iff.states: ∀ {rs : List Loops.Record} {o : Option String} {r : Loops.Record}, Loops.liveK rs o r = true ↔ Loops.setsK o r = true ∧ ∀ (q : Loops.Record), q ∈ Loops.above rs r → Loops.setsK o q = false

Loops.Lens.parse_body.states: ∀ (id : Loops.Lens.Line) (body b rest : List Loops.Lens.Line) (acc : List Loops.Lens.Section), Loops.Lens.parseGo (List.map Loops.Lens.escape body ++ Loops.Lens.fence :: rest) (Loops.Lens.St.inside id b) acc = Loops.Lens.parseGo rest Loops.Lens.St.top ({ id := id, body := b.reverse ++ body } :: acc)

Loops.Lens.parseGo.eq_def.states: ∀ (x : List Loops.Lens.Line) (x_1 : Loops.Lens.St) (x_2 : List Loops.Lens.Section), Loops.Lens.parseGo x x_1 x_2 = match x, x_1, x_2 with | [], Loops.Lens.St.top, acc => some acc.reverse | [], Loops.Lens.St.inside id body, x => none | l :: ls, Loops.Lens.St.top, acc => match Loops.Lens.headerId? l with | some id => Loops.Lens.parseGo ls (Loops.Lens.St.inside id []) acc | none => none | l :: ls, Loops.Lens.St.inside id b, acc => if l = Loops.Lens.fence then Loops.Lens.parseGo ls Loops.Lens.St.top ({ id := id, body := b.reverse } :: acc) else if List.take 3 l = Loops.Lens.fence then none else Loops.Lens.parseGo ls (Loops.Lens.St.inside id (Loops.Lens.unescape l :: b)) acc

Loops.Env.problem_unreadable.states: ∀ {e : Loops.Env}, (e.kind = Loops.unreadable ∨ e.observer = Loops.unreadable ∨ e.emitted = Loops.unreadable ∨ e.occurred = some Loops.unreadable ∨ Loops.unreadable ∈ e.about ∨ e.of = some Loops.unreadable ∨ Loops.unreadable ∈ e.prev ∨ e.under = some Loops.unreadable ∨ Loops.unreadable ∈ e.erases ∨ ∃ xs, e.sets = some xs ∧ Loops.unreadable ∈ xs) → e.problem ≠ none

Loops.Env.problem_codes.states: ∀ {e : Loops.Env} {c : String}, e.problem = some c → c ∈ Loops.writeCodes

Loops.Env.mk.injEq.states: ∀ (kind observer emitted : String) (occurred : Option String) (about : List String) (of : Option String) (prev : List String) (under : Option String) (erases : List String) (sets : Option (List String)) (kind_1 observer_1 emitted_1 : String) (occurred_1 : Option String) (about_1 : List String) (of_1 : Option String) (prev_1 : List String) (under_1 : Option String) (erases_1 : List String) (sets_1 : Option (List String)), ({ kind := kind, observer := observer, emitted := emitted, occurred := occurred, about := about, of := of, prev := prev, under := under, erases := erases, sets := sets } = { kind := kind_1, observer := observer_1, emitted := emitted_1, occurred := occurred_1, about := about_1, of := of_1, prev := prev_1, under := under_1, erases := erases_1, sets := sets_1 }) = (kind = kind_1 ∧ observer = observer_1 ∧ emitted = emitted_1 ∧ occurred = occurred_1 ∧ about = about_1 ∧ of = of_1 ∧ prev = prev_1 ∧ under = under_1 ∧ erases = erases_1 ∧ sets = sets_1)

Loops.Env.mk.inj.states: ∀ {kind observer emitted : String} {occurred : Option String} {about : List String} {of : Option String} {prev : List String} {under : Option String} {erases : List String} {sets : Option (List String)} {kind_1 observer_1 emitted_1 : String} {occurred_1 : Option String} {about_1 : List String} {of_1 : Option String} {prev_1 : List String} {under_1 : Option String} {erases_1 : List String} {sets_1 : Option (List String)}, { kind := kind, observer := observer, emitted := emitted, occurred := occurred, about := about, of := of, prev := prev, under := under, erases := erases, sets := sets } = { kind := kind_1, observer := observer_1, emitted := emitted_1, occurred := occurred_1, about := about_1, of := of_1, prev := prev_1, under := under_1, erases := erases_1, sets := sets_1 } → kind = kind_1 ∧ observer = observer_1 ∧ emitted = emitted_1 ∧ occurred = occurred_1 ∧ about = about_1 ∧ of = of_1 ∧ prev = prev_1 ∧ under = under_1 ∧ erases = erases_1 ∧ sets = sets_1

Loops.Draft.mk.injEq.states: ∀ (label : Option String) (env : Loops.Env) (salt : List UInt8) (payload : Loops.Json) (label_1 : Option String) (env_1 : Loops.Env) (salt_1 : List UInt8) (payload_1 : Loops.Json), ({ label := label, env := env, salt := salt, payload := payload } = { label := label_1, env := env_1, salt := salt_1, payload := payload_1 }) = (label = label_1 ∧ env = env_1 ∧ salt = salt_1 ∧ payload = payload_1)

Loops.Draft.mk.inj.states: ∀ {label : Option String} {env : Loops.Env} {salt : List UInt8} {payload : Loops.Json} {label_1 : Option String} {env_1 : Loops.Env} {salt_1 : List UInt8} {payload_1 : Loops.Json}, { label := label, env := env, salt := salt, payload := payload } = { label := label_1, env := env_1, salt := salt_1, payload := payload_1 } → label = label_1 ∧ env = env_1 ∧ salt = salt_1 ∧ payload = payload_1

Loops.Down.reach.states: ∀ {S W : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Down S W → ∀ {r : Loops.Record} {i : Loops.RecordId}, Loops.Reach W [r.id] i → ∀ (b : Loops.Record), b ∈ S → i ∈ b.prev → Loops.Reach S [r.id] i

Loops.Down.part.states: ∀ {S W : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Down S W → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ S → r ∈ W

Loops.Down.names.states: ∀ {S W : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Down S W → ∀ (y : Loops.Record), y ∈ S → ∀ (x : Loops.Record), x ∈ W → x.id ∈ y.prev → x ∈ S

Loops.Down.below.states: ∀ {S W : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Down S W → ∀ {x b : Loops.Record}, x ∈ W → b ∈ S → b ∈ Loops.above W x → x ∈ S

Loops.Down.above_iff.states: ∀ {S W : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Down S W → ∀ {r q : Loops.Record}, q ∈ Loops.above S r ↔ q ∈ S ∧ q ∈ Loops.above W r

Loops.Distinct.filter.states: ∀ {xs : List Loops.Record} (p : Loops.Record → Bool), Loops.Distinct xs → Loops.Distinct (List.filter p xs)

Loops.Distinct.addressed.states: ∀ {xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Distinct xs → Loops.Addressed xs

Loops.Covers.witnessed.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (o : Option String), Loops.Witnessed (Loops.recordsOf t ys) (Loops.recordsOf t xs) o

Loops.Covers.thingTest.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (cs : List Loops.Cond), Loops.thingTest cs (Loops.recordsOf t ys) = Loops.thingTest cs (Loops.recordsOf t xs)

Loops.Covers.thingKeys.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → Loops.Addressed xs → Loops.Addressed ys → ∀ (b : Loops.By) (sel : Loops.Record → Bool) (cs : List Loops.Cond), b.thingKeys sel cs ys t = b.thingKeys sel cs xs t

Loops.Covers.thingEv.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → Loops.Addressed xs → Loops.Addressed ys → ∀ (sel : Loops.Record → Bool) (cs : List Loops.Cond), Loops.thingEv sel cs ys t = Loops.thingEv sel cs xs t

Loops.Covers.sub.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ Loops.recordsOf t ys → r ∈ Loops.recordsOf t xs

Loops.Covers.soleSetter.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → Loops.Addressed xs → Loops.Addressed ys → ∀ (f : String), Loops.soleSetter ys f t = Loops.soleSetter xs f t

Loops.Covers.mem_liveFor.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (f : String) (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ List.filter (Loops.liveFor (Loops.recordsOf t ys) f) (Loops.recordsOf t ys) ↔ r ∈ List.filter (Loops.liveFor (Loops.recordsOf t xs) f) (Loops.recordsOf t xs)

Loops.Covers.mem_filter.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ {p q : Loops.Record → Bool}, (∀ (a : Loops.Record), a ∈ Loops.recordsOf t ys → p a = q a) → (∀ (a : Loops.Record), a ∈ Loops.recordsOf t xs → q a = true → Loops.live (Loops.recordsOf t xs) a = true) → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ List.filter p (Loops.recordsOf t ys) ↔ r ∈ List.filter q (Loops.recordsOf t xs)

Loops.Covers.liveK.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (o : Option String) (a : Loops.Record), a ∈ Loops.recordsOf t ys → Loops.liveK (Loops.recordsOf t ys) o a = Loops.liveK (Loops.recordsOf t xs) o a

Loops.Covers.liveIn.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ Loops.liveIn ys t ↔ r ∈ Loops.liveIn xs t

Loops.Covers.live.states: ∀ {t : String} {ys xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Covers t ys xs → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ Loops.recordsOf t xs → Loops.live (Loops.recordsOf t xs) r = true → r ∈ Loops.recordsOf t ys

Loops.Count.select_unread.states: ∀ (ev : Loops.Record → Loops.Tri) (xs : List Loops.Record), (Loops.Count.acc.select ev xs).unread = (List.filter (fun x => ev x == Loops.Tri.unknown) xs).length

Loops.Count.repeats.states: ∀ (xs : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.fold 0 (xs ++ xs) = 2 * Loops.Count.fold 0 xs

Loops.Count.perm.states: ∀ {xs ys : List Loops.Record}, xs.Perm ys → ∀ (n : Nat), Loops.Count.fold n xs = Loops.Count.fold n ys

Loops.Count.followed_unread.states: ∀ (sel : Loops.Record → Bool) (cs : List Loops.Cond) {xs : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Addressed xs → (Loops.Count.acc.select (fun r => if sel r = true then Loops.Cond.all cs r else Loops.Tri.no) (Loops.accPool (some Loops.Follow.prev) xs)).unread = (Loops.idsOf (List.filter (fun r => Loops.chosen sel cs r && Loops.payTest cs r == Loops.Tri.unknown) (Loops.wholeHeads xs))).length

Loops.Count.fold_eq.states: ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.fold n xs = n + xs.length

Loops.Count.batch.states: ∀ (n : Nat) (xs ys : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.fold (Loops.Count.fold n xs) ys = Loops.Count.fold n (xs ++ ys)

Loops.Count.acc_fold.states: ∀ (xs : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.acc.fold xs = Loops.Count.fold 0 xs

Loops.Cond.time_meaning.states: ∀ {f : Loops.EnvField}, f.type = Loops.FieldType.time → ∀ (op : Loops.Op) {r r' : Loops.Record}, Option.map (fun x => x.span) r.occurred = Option.map (fun x => x.span) r'.occurred → r.emitted.moment = r'.emitted.moment → { field := Loops.Field.env f, op := op }.eval r = { field := Loops.Field.env f, op := op }.eval r'

Loops.Cond.text_is.states: ∀ (t : String) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.kind, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str t)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (t == r.kind) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.observer, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str t)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (t == r.observer)

Loops.Cond.set_present.states: ∀ (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.about, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool !r.about.isEmpty ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.prev, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool !r.prev.isEmpty ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.under, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool r.under.isSome ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.erases, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool !r.erases.isEmpty

Loops.Cond.onThing_unset.states: ∀ {c : Loops.Cond} {f : String}, c.field = Loops.Field.payload f → ∀ {rs : List Loops.Record}, (∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ rs → Loops.liveFor rs f r = false) → c.onThing rs = Loops.Tri.ofBool (c.op.test [])

Loops.Cond.onThing_unheld.states: ∀ {c : Loops.Cond} {f : String}, c.field = Loops.Field.payload f → ∀ {rs : List Loops.Record} {r : Loops.Record}, r ∈ rs → Loops.liveFor rs f r = true → r.shown ≠ Loops.Shown.here → c.onThing rs = Loops.Tri.unknown

Loops.Cond.onThing_payload.states: ∀ {c : Loops.Cond} {f : String}, c.field = Loops.Field.payload f → ∀ (rs : List Loops.Record), c.onThing rs = Loops.Tri.agree (List.map c.eval (List.filter (Loops.liveFor rs f) rs)) (Loops.Tri.ofBool (c.op.test []))

Loops.Cond.onThing_differ.states: ∀ {c : Loops.Cond} {f : String}, c.field = Loops.Field.payload f → ∀ {rs : List Loops.Record} {q r : Loops.Record}, q ∈ rs → Loops.liveFor rs f q = true → r ∈ rs → Loops.liveFor rs f r = true → c.eval q ≠ c.eval r → c.onThing rs = Loops.Tri.unknown

Loops.Cond.onThing_congr.states: ∀ {rs rs' : List Loops.Record}, (∀ (q : Loops.Record), q ∈ rs ↔ q ∈ rs') → ∀ (c : Loops.Cond), c.onThing rs = c.onThing rs'

Loops.Cond.onThing_agree.states: ∀ {c : Loops.Cond} {f : String}, c.field = Loops.Field.payload f → ∀ {rs : List Loops.Record} {r : Loops.Record}, r ∈ rs → Loops.liveFor rs f r = true → ∀ {a : Loops.Tri}, (∀ (q : Loops.Record), q ∈ rs → Loops.liveFor rs f q = true → c.eval q = a) → c.onThing rs = a

Loops.Cond.of_is.states: ∀ (t : String) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.of, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str t)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (r.of.toList.contains t) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.of, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool r.of.isSome

Loops.Cond.occurred_missing.states: ∀ (a : Loops.Arg) {r : Loops.Record}, r.occurred = none → { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.atLeast a }.eval r = Loops.Tri.no ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.below a }.eval r = Loops.Tri.no

Loops.Cond.occurred_is.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∃ k, r.occurred = some k ∧ k.span = c.span

Loops.Cond.occurred_below.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.below (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∃ k, r.occurred = some k ∧ k.span.start < c.span.start

Loops.Cond.occurred_atLeast.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.atLeast (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∃ k, r.occurred = some k ∧ c.span.start ≤ k.span.start

Loops.Cond.mk.sizeOf_spec.states: ∀ (field : Loops.Field) (op : Loops.Op), sizeOf { field := field, op := op } = 1 + sizeOf field + sizeOf op

Loops.Cond.mk.inj.states: ∀ {field : Loops.Field} {op : Loops.Op} {field_1 : Loops.Field} {op_1 : Loops.Op}, { field := field, op := op } = { field := field_1, op := op_1 } → field = field_1 ∧ op = op_1

Loops.Cond.id_is.states: ∀ (i : String) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.prev, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str i)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool ((List.map Loops.idText r.prev).contains i) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.under, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str i)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool ((List.map Loops.idText r.under.toList).contains i) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.erases, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str i)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool ((List.map Loops.idText r.erases).contains i)

Loops.Cond.eval_view.states: ∀ {f : Loops.Record → Loops.Record}, Loops.View f → ∀ (c : Loops.Cond) (r : Loops.Record), (c.eval (f r)).Refines (c.eval r)

Loops.Cond.eval_here.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Cond) {r : Loops.Record}, r.shown = Loops.Shown.here → c.eval r ≠ Loops.Tri.unknown
